achievements.name: Heroic Match
achievements.detail: Win an arena match in the Heroic Games after placing your team on the field.

achievements.name: Combat Art
achievements.detail: Spend weapon durability on a Combat Art for a heavier hit in an arena battle.

achievements.name: Blaze Art
achievements.detail: Spend a hero's health to unleash their Blaze Art in an arena battle.

achievements.name: Rewind
achievements.detail: Use Fortuna's Blessing to rewind an arena battle and play a turn again.

achievements.name: Arena Training
achievements.detail: During free time in Dagsion, train a unit in the arena and raise a weapon skill.

achievements.name: Temple Service
achievements.detail: Volunteer at Temple Row and earn a blessing you can use in battle.

achievements.name: New Recruit
achievements.detail: Convince a warrior in Dagsion to join you with a gift or a shared meal.

achievements.name: Inn Bond
achievements.detail: Share a meal at a Dagsion inn and raise your bond with that ally.

achievements.name: Timed Quest
achievements.detail: Accept a townsfolk quest in Dagsion and finish it before the deadline.

achievements.name: Road Skirmish
achievements.detail: Defeat an enemy group in a skirmish on the world map outside Dagsion.

achievements.name: Dungeon Clear
achievements.detail: Clear a dungeon on the world map and bring back materials from its battles.

achievements.name: Other Hero
achievements.detail: At the Pale Raven's Perch, switch heroes and continue that hero's saved progress.

achievements.name: Advanced Class
achievements.detail: Pass an Advanced certification exam in Dagsion and field that class in an arena match.
